get.description: The account's sessions, newest first (also after Pro ends: they are the member's own).

post.description:
Convene the advisors on one question about one stock. Streams the session as SSE events
(`data: {...}` lines): session, stage, writing, turn, result, error, done.

Emails a link to choose a new password. The answer never says whether an account has
this email, and the email goes out after the answer, so its timing does not say it either.
What the new-password page needs to know before it is filled in. Uses nothing up.

Sets a new password with the emailed link's token, once and within the hour. Every
session of the account ends (one opened with the old password too) and this browser is
signed in with a new one. An account without a registration acceptance needs
accept_terms, which records one.

Confirms the address with the emailed link's token. Needs no session: the link may be
opened in another browser or on a phone.

Deletes the account and everything stored with it (sessions, holdings, alerts,
preferences, consents, subscription cascade). The password is asked again; an account made
with Google that never set one types its email address instead. A saved card is deleted at
Moyasar first, so nothing can be charged afterwards.
The return page's check. Moyasar's answer decides, never the redirect's query string.
Stops renewals. Pro stays on until the paid period ends.
